title: ze_FFXIV_Wanderers_Palace
description:
Ported from csgo
Map by Altima
Ported and remade by Runa & Tenshi.
The map dont rely on Pushfix
All modifications have been authorized

If you have any good suggestions or bug report, please leave a message

CS2 Change log:
1.Remake the scene, some processes have been changed
2.Item Remake:
<Black Mage Flare> replaced by <High Thunder Ⅱ>, Duration: 8s, CD: 60s, Effect: Hurt zombies and slightly slowdown them
<Summoner Shadow Flare> replaced by <Doton>, Duration: 10s, CD: 60s, Effect: Slowdown zombies
<Bird Armys Paeon> replaced by <Radiant Finale>, Duration: 10s, CD: 110s, Effect: Infinite Ammo in area
<Paladin Shield Oath> replaced by <Gravity Ⅱ>, Duration: 5s, CD: 60s, Effect: Dizzy zombie
<Mount Night Mare> replaced by <Last Bastion>, Duration: 5s, CD: 60s, Effect: Form a barrier to block zombies, it has a 3s startup time
<White Mage Benediction> replaced by <Sacred Soil>, Duration: 8s, CD: 90s, Effect: Cure humans in area, and immune infection
<Limit Break> replaced by <Chromatic Fantasy>, Delay: 20s, Limit: 1, Effect: Kill zombies in area
Remade zm item <Holmgang>, Duration: 4s, CD: 90s, Effect: Launch a chain to imprison humans who touched, ignore humans damage and <Chromatic Fantasy>'s damage
3.Added new human item:<Afflatus Purgation>, CD: 90s, Effect: Fires a laser that stuns zombies for 2 seconds, and slowly heals nearby human players, lasts for 15 seconds
4.Added new zombie items:<Wreath of Ice>, Duration: 7s, CD: 60s, Effect: Spawn an ice shield surrounding self, automatically counter‑attack attackers and slow their movement speed
<Dimensional Shift>, Duration: 3s, CD: 60s, Effect: Deals lethal damage to human players within radius
<Salted Earth>, Duration: 10s, CD: 60s, Effect: Upon spawning, pulls nearby human players towards itself, while spawning a dark zone. Continuously heals zombies within the area and deals minor damage to human players inside range
<Shadowbringer>, Duration: 1s, CD: 60s, Effect: Fires a linear‑range attack
5.Remake part boss skills
6.Remake level 5 process, delete save point
7.In level 2 (hard), the 2nd and boss fight bgm has changed to adapt to new scene, other bgms has improved quality
8.In level 4 (Savege), remake some boss skills performance, when u killed boss <Dalamud>, u need use <Last Bastion>
9.How to unlock level 5 (Ultimate) TrueEnd:
In level 1, found Lalafel (Only need to complete once, no need to clear level)
In level 2, found Black Feather and shoot it, its in a pool of water (Only need to complete once, no need to clear level)
In level 3, found small ADS (Only need to complete once, no need to clear level)
In level 4, found Alpha, its in the center of the square (Touch it and clear the level)
